sandboxInfo.title: Testing Older Versions
sandboxInfo.text: Users running JackOS Pro or JackOS Elite on JackOS v5 Beta 1 or later can test previous JackOS releases using the JackOS Sandbox Emulator. The Sandbox Emulator allows older versions to run in an isolated environment without affecting the host system or user data.

releases.summary: HTTP Server Wiring and Bug Fixes.
releases.overview: JackOS v5.1 adds bug fixes that was created when JackOS macOS came out.

sections.title: HTTP Server Wiring
items: When JackOS macOS came out, the HTTP Server was not wired up to the system. This meant that JackOS macOS was limited due to the broken server. This update fixes that issue and wires up the HTTP Server to the system.

releases.summary: The first stable release of JackOS v5.
releases.overview: JackOS v5.0 is the first stable release of the JackOS v5 series, building upon the features introduced in Beta 3.

sections.title: JackOS v5.0 Release
items: This was first update in JackOS v5.

releases.summary: The biggest JackOS update yet, turning it into a real desktop operating system.
releases.overview: JackOS v5 Beta 3 is a major expansion of the JackOS experience, adding a redesigned desktop workflow, a real Messages app, Notifications, Recovery, stronger account security, per-user taskbars and desktop layouts, built-in games, and a complete Restrictions & Screen Time system.

sections.title: Desktop & Taskbar
items: Redesigned desktop into a free-form, per-user desktop environment.
Upgraded taskbar to support per-user pins, active indicators, and built-in search.

sections.title: Communication & Alerts
items: Introduced a full Messages app featuring direct messages (DMs) and group chats.
Added a comprehensive Notification Centre alongside app icon badges.

sections.title: System, Security & Recovery
items: Built a complete standalone Recovery Environment.
Strengthened account security with Security Questions and a Recovery Key system.
Improved the protected system backup and restore process.

sections.title: Management & Control
items: Implemented full Restrictions and a Screen Time monitoring system.
Expanded account management to isolate per-user data, applications, layouts, and system permissions.
Upgraded the App Store with per-user apps, explicit permission settings, and approval requests.

sections.title: Entertainment
items: Enhanced the Games launcher and introduced standalone built-in games.

releases.summary: Added server features and some v5 features.
releases.overview: JackOS v5 Beta 2 is a major release that includes many features and is the first publically released Beta version for v5.

sections.title: New Features
items: Established Server Connection.
Fixed Major Bug Issues.
Added Sandbox Emulator

releases.overview: JackOS v4.2.1 is a security-focused maintenance release designed to strengthen account protection and improve overall system reliability.

sections.title: Security Improvements
items: Administrator authentication is now required before security questions can be modified.
Additional validation checks have been added to sensitive account-management actions.
Security hardening improvements help protect important account recovery settings.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed minor issues affecting account configuration.
Resolved several small security-related bugs.
Improved overall system stability.

releases.summary: Introduced backup, restore, and recovery tools.
releases.overview: JackOS v4.2 introduced one of the largest data-management updates in JackOS history, adding comprehensive backup and recovery tools for user data, system settings, photos, and JackOSDrive contents.

sections.title: System Backup and Restore
items: Added support for exporting and importing system backups using the .jkb format.
Backups can include accounts, passwords, wallpapers, version information, and system configuration.
Exporting requires administrator authentication.
Users must create a backup password to protect exported backups.
Importing requires administrator authentication and the original backup password.

sections.title: Photo Backup and Restore
items: Added export and import functionality for Photos.
All actions require administrator authentication.

sections.title: JackOSDrive Backup and Restore
items: Added ZIP archive export functionality for JackOSDrive.
Added ZIP archive import functionality.
Imported files are added to existing storage rather than replacing all contents.
Administrator authentication is required for both actions.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: Backup functionality requires JackOS v4.2 or later.
Backups should be restored using the same version that created them.
Version mismatch errors may occur when attempting to restore incompatible backups.

releases.summary: Major bug fixes for Browser, Photos, JCAM, and the user interface.
releases.overview: JackOS v4.1.1 focused on stability, reliability, and user-interface improvements following feedback from earlier releases.

sections.title: Browser
items: Fixed multiple browser-related issues.
Improved webpage rendering reliability.
Increased stability.

sections.title: Photos
items: Resolved issues affecting the Photos application.
Improved image loading behaviour.
Fixed file-management problems.

sections.title: JCAM
items: Addressed remaining camera-related issues.
Improved startup reliability.
Enhanced application stability.

sections.title: User Interface
items: Fixed broken interface elements.
Corrected visual inconsistencies.
Improved overall appearance and usability.

sections.title: System Changes
items: Renamed and reorganised internal system files.
Improved system structure for future development.

releases.overview: This update delivered an emergency fix for JCAM while larger user-interface improvements continued in development.

sections.title: JCAM Fixes
items: Fixed the primary issue preventing normal operation.
Improved application stability.
Restored full application functionality.

sections.title: Notes
items: Planned user-interface updates were delayed to a future release.
Development efforts were prioritised on resolving JCAM issues.

releases.summary: Major security improvements and administrative controls.
releases.overview: JackOS v4.0 marked a major security milestone and introduced stronger administrative controls throughout the operating system.

sections.title: Administrative Authentication
items: Administrator verification is now required for many sensitive actions.
Improved protection against unauthorised changes.
Enhanced security for account-management workflows.

sections.title: Security Questions
items: Fixed vulnerabilities affecting security questions.
Improved account recovery security.
Enhanced verification processes.

sections.title: Additional Security Hardening
items: General security improvements throughout the operating system.
Better protection of system settings and sensitive information.

releases.overview: A maintenance release that contributed to the foundation of future JackOS development.

sections.title: Known Information
items: Incremental improvements and refinements.
Internal changes preparing for future releases.

releases.overview: One of the most visually significant updates released during the JackOS v3 lifecycle.

sections.title: User Interface Refresh
items: Introduced a substantially redesigned interface.
Modernised the desktop experience.
Improved visual consistency throughout the operating system.

releases.overview: The first publicly released version of JackOS and the foundation of all future releases.

sections.title: Historical Milestones
items: First public JackOS release.
Initial desktop environment.
Early JackOS system architecture.
Beginning of the JackOS release timeline.
